---
title: "check-corollary-sources.yml"
---

Diff-scoped, warn-only check for the lab's rule
(Ezra, 2026-11-16;
psw's Using theorem environments in Quarto section)
that a corollary follows directly from one earlier result
and names that result.
A corollary that names nothing leaves the reader
to guess what it follows from,
and is usually a proposition typed as a corollary.

The check flags a `#cor-` div
whose statement and proof name no earlier result.
A result is named by either:

- a cross-reference such as `@thm-id`, `@lem-id`, `@cor-id`, or `@prp-id`;
  or
- a Markdown link whose target ends in such an anchor,
  on this site or another one.

The check reads the corollary's proof in any of three places:

- a `.proof` div nested in the corollary;
- a `.proof` div that follows the corollary with only blank lines between;
- a `.proof` div inside a wrapper div with no id,
  such as `.content-hidden`, that follows the corollary.

The corollary's own id does not count,
and neither does a citation inside a comment or a code fence.
A corollary that follows from a definition or an axiom alone
is exempt with `<!-- check-corollary-sources: allow: reason -->`
in the div or its proof;
a pragma with no reason does not exempt it.

Whether a result is central, smaller, or a proof step
is a judgment that no pattern can make,
so the rest of the rule is a review item.

A corollary is checked when the pull request adds a line
inside it or its proof.
With no base to diff against,
the check skips instead of scanning the whole tree.
It only warns by default;
set `fail: true` after a measured corpus shows no false positive.

## Inputs

| Input | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `globs` | `*.qmd` | Git pathspecs of tracked files to check (recursive) |
| `paths-ignore` | none | Comma or newline separated globs to skip |
| `fail` | `false` | Fail on a finding; `false` warns |
| `whole-tree` | `false` | Check every corollary, to measure a corpus |
| `python-version` | `3.x` | Python version |
| `runs-on` | empty (`CI_RUNNER` variable, else `ubuntu-latest`) | Runner label; a self-hosted label only for a private repository |

## Usage

Copy `examples/check-corollary-sources.yml` to
`.github/workflows/check-corollary-sources.yml`.
